judged_text: BaseCalendarService.createEvent filters the creating credential's own calendar list by the main host's `destinationCalendar[0].externalId`, an ID that no team member's credential calendar list contains. For collective bookings on base-class calendars (CalDav/Apple), the per-host calls for non-first destinations match zero calendars and create nothing, so only the main host's event exists — silently, since the empty result is not surfaced as a failure.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/lib/CalendarService.ts` (BaseCalendarService), event creation filters the credential’s `calendars` list by `mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId`, where `mainHostDestinationCalendar` is taken as the first element of `event.destinationCalendar` (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` and `filter((c) => mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId ? c.externalId === mainHostDestinationCalendar.externalId : true)`). With the diff’s change to make `destinationCalendar` an array and the new collective/team logic in `handleNewBooking` that appends additional members’ destination calendars after the organizer’s (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`), per-credential event creation (via `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` calling `createEvent(...)` for each destination/credential) will still filter by destinationCalendar[0].externalId (the main host), which other members’ credentials’ calendar lists likely won’t contain. That yields an empty `Promise.all([])` and effectively creates no event for those members without surfacing an error.
